newsitem.title: GERMANY: Growth potential seen in European aluminium demand.
newsitem.headline: Growth potential seen in European aluminium demand.

text.p: Aluminium industry prospects in Europe may improve over the next 12 months on increased demand, VAW chairman Joachen Schirner said on Monday.

Schirner, who heads Germany's leading integrated producer, a unit of VIAG AG, told a Metal Bulletin industry conference that economic institutes were forecasting a considerable pick-up in economic activity in Europe in the near term.
Schirner was slightly more cautious. "But I do foresee a certain growth potential over the next few months," he said.
Even the ailing construction sector was reporting an increase in new orders for billets and extrusions.
Current LME prices were exactly at the average seen over the past 15 years, Schirner said.
Demand increases might add some 10 percent to prices.
